verdict.rationale: Ironclad's current evidence pack describes a Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) platform — API-driven contract creation, signing, storage, workflow, and AI features — with no capability for Delaware state incorporation filing, drafting/adopting bylaws, or documenting initial board approvals. The few community comments referencing 'Delaware C-Corp' templates (ironclad-comm-5, ironclad-comm-9) are unanswered questions from an early HN thread, not confirmed proof the product performs state filings or formation services akin to Clerky/Stripe Atlas, so this is a category mismatch rather than an unmet capability of the current product.
